text_markup: Programs with the subtype {subtype:icebreaker} have a printed numerical strength value. An {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength determines which ice it is allowed to interface with. See {ref:subsec_icebreakers}.
text_plain: Programs with the subtype icebreaker have a printed numerical strength value. An icebreaker's strength determines which ice it is allowed to interface with. See section 3.9.5.
